answer: Every claim climbs the willow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quill re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
